detaileddescription.para: Returns the domain-local reading, or std::nullopt to signal a source failure. The authority never fabricates time and never falls back to another domain. Unit specification: T025-U-TYPES

briefdescription.para: Reports whether a candidate action mask contains only defined bits.

simplesect.para: true when mask is non-zero and contains no undefined action bit.

briefdescription.para: Reports whether a candidate action mask holds exactly one bit.

simplesect.para: true when mask contains exactly one bit.

briefdescription.para: Converts an action into its single-bit mask.
Returns the stable name of a single defined action mask.

simplesect.para: The stable, non-empty action name for a single defined action bit, or an empty view for a zero, composite, or undefined-bit mask. A mask containing an undefined bit is never named as a defined action.

briefdescription.para: Reports whether a lifecycle state is terminal.

briefdescription.para: Returns the zero-based precedence rank of a result code.

briefdescription.para: Orders two result codes by precedence rank.

simplesect.para: Strong ordering by precedence rank, so that a lower rank is "less".

briefdescription.para: Computes the deterministic 128-bit FNV-1a content digest of a byte sequence.

briefdescription.para: Returns the action that produced a lifecycle state, if any.

briefdescription.para: Exhaustive constexpr evaluation of the lifecycle transition table.

simplesect.para: TransitionOutcome::TerminalState from a terminal state (except a safe repeat of the producing action, which is AlreadyApplied); AlreadyApplied for a safe idempotent repeat; Ok for a legal forward transition; otherwise InvalidTransition.
